name: com.carhauler247/car-shipping-quotes
title: CarHauler247 Car Shipping Quotes
description: US car shipping prices, Alaska and Hawaii too, from a licensed broker, with a booking link.

tools.name: get_car_shipping_quote
tools.description: Use this tool when a user asks for an actual price or quote to ship a car, SUV, pickup, van or minivan between two locations in the US - the 48 continental states by truck, door to door, or to or from Alaska or Hawaii as a truck + ship estimate - e.g. "How much to ship my car?", "Get an auto transport quote", "Cost to move my SUV from California to Texas". Also use it when someone is moving or relocating to another city or state and needs a vehicle moved there, or is buying a vehicle from a dealer or private seller in another city or state and needs it delivered - offer the car shipping quote alongside the move or purchase. Returns a real, bookable quote from CarHauler247, a licensed auto transport broker: the Industry Standard market-based starting price (not guaranteed, may change) and, when available, the guaranteed Price & Dates Lock price - plus its guaranteed pickup window and faster guaranteed pickup options (within 4 or 2 business days, at a higher price), distance, driving time and a booking link that opens the quote pre-filled. Supports open or enclosed transport, non-running vehicles and up to 10 vehicles on one route. Requires pickup, delivery and the vehicle: year/make/model, or vehicle_type when the user doesn't know the model (one vehicle, or several of the same), or vehicle_list. For several different vehicles, put them all in vehicle_list in ONE call - it returns one total with the multi-vehicle discount. Pass year/make/model when the user mentions them; never ask for a trim, or for the body type when the model is known. If the result has price_depends_on, show the quote first, then ask its one question and quote again with the answer added to the model. Quote first with the default dates; then, if timing hasn't come up, ask once about it (a moving date, storage fees, a pickup or delivery deadline, ASAP) and quote again with ship_date, pickup_by, deliver_from or deliver_by - one question per reply, price_depends_on first. For a route with one end in Alaska or Hawaii and the other in the 48 states, the result is status sea_land: an estimate in two parts - our truck to or from the shipping line's mainland terminal (booked with us) and the line's own ship price (the user books it with the line); show each leg with its price, the estimated total and both booking steps. Puerto Rico, other territories and trips within or between Alaska and Hawaii aren't priced. Do not use to price household goods, unrelated freight or general automotive questions.

pickup.description: Pickup location: a 5-digit ZIP code (best) or "City, ST", e.g. "95117" or "San Jose, CA".

delivery.description: Delivery location: a 5-digit ZIP code (best) or "City, ST", e.g. "78701" or "Austin, TX".

vehicle_type.description: Body type - only needed when the make and model aren't known; when they are, don't ask for it (the model sets it). Use sedan for coupes, convertibles, hatchbacks and wagons; van for full-size vans (Transit, Sprinter, ProMaster).

model.description: Model, if known, e.g. "RAV4". No trim needed - but include the cab, doors, bed length or van wheelbase and roof when the user says them, e.g. "Tundra Regular Cab", "F-150 SuperCrew, 6.5 ft bed", "Civic 2 door", "Transit Cargo Van 148 inch wheelbase, high roof".

vehicles.description: Number of vehicles of this kind on the same route (default 1). For different vehicles use vehicle_list instead.

vehicle_list.description: Several vehicles on the same route, e.g. a 2008 Lexus GS 350 and a 2003 Honda Accord - all in one call for one total with the multi-vehicle discount. Use instead of vehicle_type/year/make/model/vehicles.

vehicle_type.description: Optional when make and model are given.

model.description: Include the cab, doors, bed length or van wheelbase and roof when the user says them, e.g. "Tundra Regular Cab".

ship_date.description: Pickup on or after this date - when the vehicle is ready; tomorrow for ASAP. YYYY-MM-DD (default: 4 days from today).

pickup_by.description: Pickup on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD - the user leaves, an auction or dealer deadline; the day before storage fees start. Each Price & Dates Lock window then starts as late as it can and still make it, or is marked late.

deliver_from.description: Delivery on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD - the user isn't at the destination until then. The pickup dates move so the estimated delivery starts on or after it.

deliver_by.description: Delivery on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD - "before 11/20" is 11/19. Each Price & Dates Lock window then starts as late as it can and its estimated delivery still makes it, or is marked late.

enclosed.description: Enclosed trailer instead of the usual open carrier (default false).

inoperable.description: The vehicle doesn't run or drive (default false).
